body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 5 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target gains +1 Fortitude against the next attack targeting it and reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn. Its next successful attack may push one hit enemy 1 unit during that time.

surges.html: The target's next attack ignores 1 point of cover bonus until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Imbuement
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: bind the target. Trigger: it pushes or pulls an enemy with a Combat Card. Echo: grant +1 Harmony against the next attack targeting it before your next turn.
